506 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTIONS 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT AND THE COMPLAINT DATED 17.12.2022 PENDING ON THE FILE OF IV CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C., HASSAN VIDE ANNEXURES - A AND B AND ALLOW THIS PETITION.
 THESE PETITIONS, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners in Crl.P.No.5572/2023 and Crl.P.No.7041/2023 submits that the Police have already filed the charge-sheet.
Hence, learned counsel seeking permission to withdraw the petitions with liberty to file fresh petitions by challenging the charge-sheet.
2. The submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is placed on record.
Accordingly, Crl.P.No.5572/2023 and Crl.P.No.7041/2023 are dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
4. Learned counsel for respondent No.2 in Crl.P.No.7717/2023 submits that the Police have filed the charge-sheet even prior to passing of the Interim Order on 07.09.2023.
5. The submission of learned counsel for respondent No.2. is placed on record.
The interim order granted on 07.09.2023.
The charge-sheet filed on 29.08.2023.
Therefore, the question of staying the FIR does not arise.
6. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner seeking permission to withdraw the petition with liberty to file a fresh petition by challenging the charge-sheet.
7. The submission of learned counsel for the petitioner is placed on record.
